text:
Jordan: quick flag 1: dashboard p99 on /embed-api shows discrepancy vs raw samples after last ingest window tweak. p50/p95 match but p99 diverges by ~90ms.
Maya: interesting, did we change aggregation windows?
Jordan: yes  we moved from fixed 1m slices to a decaying 5m window for tdigest snapshots at 02:00 UTC to smooth spikes
Evan: that can shift percentiles. decaying windows bias recent samples but also mix sample counts across shards unevenly
Zoe: could be time-alignment issue too: frontend charts use event_time while backend rollups use ingest_time, so a routing change can appear delayed/misaligned in the UI
Jordan: i pulled raw samples for same interval: p99 from raw = 420ms, rolled tdigest p99 = 510ms. sample_count for p99 bucket ~220, p95 sample_count ~9k
Maya: so two things to check: (1) decaying-window semantics increasing weight of a transient tail, (2) tdigest merge losing per-shard sample counts -> rolled tail distortion, (3) event vs ingest time mismatch
Evan: reproduction idea: run a short controlled test that emits a 1% spike of long requests at T0, then compare how fixed-1m, decaying-5m, and raw-sample percentiles evolve over 10m
Zoe: UX asks from this: show the aggregation mode (fixed/decay), window length, and a little "time-origin" label (event_time vs ingest_time) on the latency chart. also surface per-shard sample counts on hover
Jordan: also propose a small "explain" popup when p99 jumps that lists recent config changes (routing, quotas, aggregation) pulled from provenance events
Maya: backend fix: include per-shard sample_count and origin tag (route/quota) when merging tdigest, and allow frontend to compute a confidence indicator or reconstruct pooled raw samples for small-n p99s
Evan: analytics: compute bootstrap CI for percentiles when samples < 1000 and show a faint band around p99. we can compute approximate CI from tdigest by resampling if we have per-shard counts or materialize small raw sample buffers for recent windows
Zoe: short-term mitigations:
- show sample_count badge next to p99 (Jordan)
- annotate charts with last routing/quota/aggregation config change (Maya)
- add a toggle to switch aggregation mode to "raw-samples" for the last 15m for debugging (Evan)
metrics-bot: deploy-bot: noted request: Jordan -> add sample_count badge to p99 UI, Maya -> add provenance annotation to charts
Jordan: i'll open a postmortem draft linking the controlled test plan and UI changes. also will monitor after we roll annotation + badge
Maya: i'll start the provenance annex and chart label PR.
Evan: i'll prototype a small bootstrap CI routine and a debug toggle for raw-samples.
Zoe: thanks. long-term: surface per-variant percentiles, show source-of-truth timestamp, and compute percentile confidence so product teams don't chase low-n artifacts.
Jordan: agreed. closing watch window, will update thread when test runs complete.
